name: Cadenza
comment: Baseline lexical highlighting for Cadenza (both the ML and s-expression surfaces). The `cdz lsp` server refines this at load time with SEMANTIC tokens (colour by what a name MEANS, from the compiler's resolved column); this TextMate grammar is the lexical fallback the editor paints before/without the server. Keyword set mirrors guide/src/editor/cadenzaLanguage.ts.

patterns.comment: A `///` doc comment — matched BEFORE the `//` rule (TextMate tries patterns in order) so a doc comment gets the distinct documentation scope an editor themes apart from an ordinary comment.
patterns.name: comment.line.documentation.cadenza

annotations.comment: An `@annotation` — `@test`, `@exhaustive`, `@inline-never`, and the call-style `@tag("…")` / `@param(…)`. The sigil plus the annotation name is a decorator on the following definition (the `cdz lsp` server paints these as `keyword` semantic tokens; this is the lexical fallback). Matched BEFORE `#operators` so the leading `@` is claimed here as part of the annotation rather than as a bare operator. Kebab names allowed (`inline-never`). The call-style argument list is left to the ordinary rules (its string/name children paint normally).
annotations.name: entity.name.tag.annotation.cadenza

constructors.comment: A Capitalized identifier — a type or a variant constructor. Semantic tokens distinguish the two; lexically we colour both as a type name.
constructors.name: entity.name.type.cadenza
